description: This file defines the DetailedLeaveRequest class, which manages leave request-related calculations and data handling in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It manages leave entities, calculates leave durations, handles leave periods, and manages workflow actions and statuses for leave requests.

classes.name: DetailedLeaveRequest
classes.description: Main class managing leave request calculations, leave entities, leave periods, leave balances, and workflow actions in the OrangeHRM leave module.

methods.name: setLeaveRequest
methods.description: Sets the LeaveRequest entity and resets internal state.

methods.name: fetchLeaves
methods.description: Fetches all leave entities associated with the leave request and stores them internally.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns the list of leave entities, sorted by date.

methods.name: setLeaves
methods.description: Sets the list of leave entities and updates internal date and leave arrays.

methods.name: addLeave
methods.description: Adds a leave entity to the internal list and resets sorting.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leave entities.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of leave days.

methods.name: getDatesDetail
methods.description: Returns detailed date information about the leave request.

methods.name: getLeaveBreakdown
methods.description: Returns breakdown of leaves by status, excluding weekends and holidays.

methods.name: getLeaveBalances
methods.description: Returns the leave balances for each leave period.

methods.name: getLeavePeriods
methods.description: Calculates and returns the leave periods associated with the leaves.

methods.name: hasMultipleStatus
methods.description: Indicates whether the leave request has multiple statuses.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Returns list of allowed actions for the leave request based on current status.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Fetches allowed workflows for a given leave status.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is allowed on the leave request.

methods.name: getWorkflowForAction
methods.description: Returns the workflow associated with a specific action.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the leave request; throws exception if multiple statuses are detected.
